paper_title: Natural selection on body coloration in Drosophila suzukii (chill-coma recovery sample counts contradict the stated per-group n)
paper_authors: Biological Journal of the Linnean Society (2025); DOI 10.1093/biolinnean/blaf057. PubPeer-reported sample-count inconsistency (Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.c866t1ghd).

data.note: Dryad deposit. Sheet 'chill coma recovery duration(s)' has 6 columns (15/20/25 C x male/female). The paper's Methods state 100 males and 100 females per temperature were used for the chill-coma assay, but the recorded per-column counts are 74/223/14/51/99/138 — far from 100, most severely 20 C male n=14.

Column C (C2:C15) holds exactly 14 non-empty individual measurements; C16 onward is empty. The stated per-group n in the paper's Methods is 100 males per temperature.

sheet 'chill coma recovery duration(s)', C2:C15 — the full block of individual 20 C male chill-coma measurements; 14 non-empty rows = actual n=14 for this group (vs the stated 100). This group is also cited in the Methods as supplying the 30 individuals needed for a mate-choice experiment, which n=14 cannot satisfy.

sheet 'chill coma recovery duration(s)', E2 — first recorded chill-coma recovery duration for the 25 C male group. Column E (E2:E100) holds 99 non-empty measurements, essentially matching the stated n=100 for this group.

claims.claim_atom: The paper's Methods state that 100 males and 100 females of D. suzukii per temperature were assayed for chill-coma recovery. In the raw data (data.xlsx, sheet 'chill coma recovery duration(s)'), the 20 C male group (column C, C2:C15) contains only 14 individual measurements — the first is C2=102.55 s and the column is empty from C16. n=14 is nowhere near the stated 100. The discrepancy is compounded because the Methods also cite the 20 C male group as the source of the 30 individuals required for a mate-choice experiment, which a pool of 14 cannot supply. Across all six groups the recorded counts are 74/223/14/51/99/138, none of which is 100. This is a sample_count_mismatch, invisible to the file-internal numeric detectors: (1) the duplicate-column detector compares columns for byte-identity or offset — irrelevant, no values are duplicated; (2) fixed-offset / paired-ratio detectors look for arithmetic relations between columns — none is at issue; (3) the anomaly is a COUNT of rows versus a number stated only in the paper's prose, not any numeric relationship inside the file, so a src-vs-tgt value comparison on the claim locus (single cell C2) returns 'independent'. Detecting it requires reading the stated per-group n from the Methods and counting the non-empty rows in the corresponding column.
claims._adjudication: inconsistent: 論文 Methods は各温度で雄 100・雌 100 を chill-coma アッセイに用いたと記載。生データの 20 C 雄群(列 C, C2:C15)は 14 個体のみ(C2=102.55、C16 以降空)で、記載 100 と大きく矛盾。さらに 20 C 雄群は 30 個体を要する mate-choice 実験の供給源とも記載され、14 では不可能。全 6 群の実測数は 74/223/14/51/99/138 で 100 の群は皆無。B3 検出器はファイル内数値列関係を探すが、これは行数 vs 論文本文記載 n という異種比較であり、単一セル C2 は independent 判定→no_flag。発見には Methods の記載 n を読み、対応列の非空行を数える必要がある。

claims.claim_atom: The 25 C male group (column E, E2:E100) contains 99 individual chill-coma measurements, the first being E2=122.36 s. This is within one individual of the stated per-group n=100 and is therefore consistent with the Methods — a minor, biologically ordinary shortfall (one individual lost or excluded) rather than a structural discrepancy. Unlike the 20 C male group (n=14), this group's recorded count matches the stated design.
claims._adjudication: consistent(clean): 25 C 雄群(列 E, E2:E100)は 99 個体(E2=122.36)で、記載 n=100 と 1 個体差=生物学的に通常の欠損範囲であり Methods と整合。20 C 雄群(n=14)と異なり構造的矛盾なし。clean claim。

claims.claim_atom: The first recorded 20 C male chill-coma value C2=102.55 s is itself an ordinary, in-range measurement: chill-coma recovery durations for males across the dataset span roughly 100-160 s, and 102.55 s sits at the low end, entirely plausible for an individual fly. The value at this locus is not itself anomalous — the problem with the 20 C male group is the number of such values (14, not 100), not any individual reading. Treated as a single measurement, C2 is consistent with the data distribution.
claims._adjudication: consistent(clean): 20 C 雄群の最初の値 C2=102.55 s 自体は正常な範囲内の測定(雄の chill-coma は概ね 100-160 s、102.55 は低め端で妥当)。20 C 雄群の問題は値の個数(14 であって 100 でない)であり個々の測定値ではない。単一測定として C2 はデータ分布と整合。clean claim。

metadata._pubpeer_gt: Methods state 100 males + 100 females per temperature for chill-coma recovery, but Sheet2 'chill coma recovery duration(s)' records per-group n of 14-223 (74/223/14/51/99/138). 20 C male n=14 but is cited as supplying 30 individuals for a mate-choice experiment.
metadata._lane: Detector-disjoint holdout case (sample_count_mismatch / #7). Anomaly = the number of recorded individuals per group contradicts the stated design n (100/group), most severely 20 C male n=14. metadata._grounding_summary: openpyxl-parsed the chill-coma sheet locally. Per-column non-empty counts: 15 C male 74, 15 C female 223, 20 C male 14, 20 C female 51, 25 C male 99, 25 C female 138. C2=102.55 (20 C male first), E2=122.36 (25 C male first). Confirms 20 C male n=14 vs stated 100, and 25 C male n=99 ~ 100.
metadata._detector_note: sample_count_mismatch is outside the B3 detector family (duplicate-column / fixed-offset / paired-ratio / cross-sheet-reuse). The discrepancy is between a row count and a number stated only in the paper prose; there is no in-file column relationship to fire on, and all claim loci are single cells scored as 'independent' (length < 2). Expected B3: no_flag on all claims.
